senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. חוּם) to be warm, hot; Pi. יִחֵם to heat.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:7">Tosef. Sabb. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:7">IV</cite>), 7 <he>מְיַיחֵם</he>, v. <cite ref="H01201"><he>חָמַם</he></cite>.—Pesik. Zutr. (ed. Bub.), Vayetsé 39 <he>ליַחְמֶנָּה</he> to heat it (the flock). Ib. 41 <he>לְיַחֵם</he>.
